z-m-10-05.title: Hanyar sauri ta nemo kewaye tana aiki koyaushe?
z-m-10-05.topic: Kewaye na siffofin da aka yi da murabba'ai na grid da iyakar hanya mai sauƙi.
z-m-10-05.goal: Gwada misalai domin gano siffofin da hanyar sauƙi ta nemo kewaye daga kewayen rectangle da ke kewaye da siffa take aiki ko ba ta aiki, sannan ka bayyana sharuddan da take aiki bisa siffofin.
z-m-10-05.material:
Murabba'in grid ɗaya murabba'i ne mai gefuna 1 cm. Siffofin da ke ƙasa an yi su ta haɗa murabba'ai gefe da gefe, babu rami a ciki. Kewaye tsawon dukkan layin iyakar waje ne, ya haɗa da iyakar wuraren da suka shiga ciki. ■ murabba'i ne na siffar, □ murabba'i babu komai, ana karanta layuka daga sama.
Siffa 가: jeri 1 ■□ / jeri 2 ■□ / jeri 3 ■■
Siffa 나: jeri 1 ■■■ / jeri 2 □■□
Siffa 다: jeri 1 ■□■ / jeri 2 ■■■
Siffa 라: jeri 1 □■□ / jeri 2 ■■■ / jeri 3 □■□
Siffa 마: jeri 1 ■□■ / jeri 2 ■□■ / jeri 3 ■■■
Jiho: 'Idan ka nemo kewaye na ƙaramin rectangle da ya kewaye siffar (ya daidaita da layukan grid), ya zama daidai da kewayen siffar. Za ka same shi da sauri!' Harin: 'Ina ƙirga gefunan waje masu tsawon 1 cm ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Yana ɗaukar lokaci amma tabbatacce ne.'
z-m-10-05.thinking.0: Gwada hanya da misalai da dama
z-m-10-05.thinking.1: Gano sharuddan da yake aiki a cikinsu da misalan karya
z-m-10-05.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri siffofi da dama da suka cika sharudda
z-m-10-05.prereq.0: Sanin kewaya ta hanyar tsawon layin iyakar siffa idan ƙaramin murabba’in grid 1 cm ne (aji na 3–4)
z-m-10-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk siffofin da darajar da hanyar Jiho ta samo (kewayen murabba’in rufewa) ta yi daidai da hanyar Harin (ainihin kewaya).
z-m-10-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowace siffa, fara rubuta murabba’ai nawa ne a faɗi da tsayi mafi ƙaramin murabba’in da ya kewaye ta.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ga iyakar waje ta kowace siffa, ƙirga gefunan 1 cm daban-daban bisa alkibla: sama, dama, ƙasa, hagu.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.a: Idan ka rasa siffa 가: ƙirga gajerun gefunan iyakar yana ba da 10 cm; kewayar murabba’in rufewa (murabba’ai 2 faɗi, 3 tsayi) ma 10 cm ne.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.b: Idan ka rasa siffa 나: iyakar 10 cm ce, kewayar murabba’in rufewa (murabba’ai 3 faɗi, 2 tsayi) ma 10 cm ce.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.c: Idan ka zaɓi siffa 다: murabba’in rufewa yana da murabba’ai 3 faɗi da 2 tsayi, kewayarsa 10 cm ce; amma idan ka ƙirga bangarori da ƙasan gurbin da ke tsakiya, ainihin kewaya 12 cm ce.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.d: Idan ka rasa siffa 라: iyakar 12 cm ce, kewayar murabba’in rufewa (murabba’ai 3 faɗi, 3 tsayi) ma 12 cm ce.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.e: Idan ka zaɓi siffa 마: murabba’in rufewa yana da murabba’ai 3 faɗi da 3 tsayi, don haka 12 cm ne, amma gurbin ya zurfafa, ainihin kewaya kuma 16 cm ce.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.explain: Ainihin kewaya da kewayar murabba’in rufewa su ne 10 cm da 10 cm ga siffa 가, 10 da 10 ga 나, 12 da 10 ga 다, 12 da 12 ga 라, 16 da 12 ga 마. Waɗanda suka yi daidai su ne 가, 나, 라. A 다 da 마 masu gurbi mai zurfi, darajar Jiho ta yi ƙasa da ainihin kewaya.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.prompt: Yi tunanin murabba’i mai faɗin w seli da tsayin h seli, an yanke gurbi mai faɗin seli 1 da zurfin d seli a wani wuri na layin sama wanda ba ƙarshensa ba. Gurbin bai kai gefen ƙasa ba, aƙalla layi 1 ya rage a ƙasansa. Misali, akwai siffa (w=3, h=2, d=1) da (w=3, h=3, d=2). Nemo siffofi 3 masu w, h, d daban-daban waɗanda tsawon iyakar waje (kewaya) ya zama 18 cm.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.hint.0: Jera ainihin kewayar siffofin (w=3, h=2, d=1) da (w=3, h=3, d=2) kusa da kewayar murabba’in da ba shi da gurbi, ka duba yadda ƙarin tsawon ya danganta da zurfin gurbin.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi w, h, d ka ƙirga kewaya kai tsaye; idan ta wuce 18 cm, rage ta, idan ta yi ƙasa kuma ƙara, ka daidaita.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Lambobi ne na halitta da ke samar da siffar.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Rubuta w a matsayin lambar halitta 3 ko fiye, h a matsayin 2 ko fiye, d kuma 1 ko fiye.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.ok.c2: Aƙalla layi 1 ya rage a ƙasa.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Gurbin ya kai gefen ƙasa. Zurfin gurbi dole ya yi ƙasa da yawan murabba’ai a tsayi da 1 aƙalla.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Kewaya ba 18 cm ba ce. Kwatanta da kewayar murabba’in da ba shi da gurbi, ka gano yadda gurbin ya ƙara kewaya.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.explain: Idan ka yanke gurbi  kewaya ita ce kewayar murabba’in da ba shi da gurbi  2×(w+h)  da aka ƙara tsawon bangarorin gurbi biyu  2×d. Yanayin da kewaya 18 cm su ne (w h d)=(3 4 2) (3 5 1) (4 3 2) (4 4 1) (5 3 1) (6 2 1).
z-m-10-05.s.s3.prompt: Ta yaya siffofin da hanyar Jiho ke aiki suka bambanta da waɗanda ba ta aiki a kansu? Rubuta irin siffar da ke sa darajar Jiho ta bambanta da ainihin kewaya.
z-m-10-05.s.s3.hint.0: Kwatanta iyakokin siffofin da ka zaɓa a tambaya ta 1 a matsayin daidai da waɗanda ba ka zaɓa ba.
z-m-10-05.s.s3.hint.1: A siffofin da ba ka zaɓa ba, nemo layukan da murabba’in kewaye ba shi da su.
z-m-10-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka bayyana a sarari bambancin siffofin da hanyar ke aiki (가, 나, 라) da waɗanda ba ta aiki (다, 마), kamar ‘gurbi da aka rufe ta ɓangarori biyu’?
z-m-10-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka rubuta yadda bambancin ya sa ainihin kewaya ta bambanta?
z-m-10-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Shin ka yi amfani da aƙalla sunan siffa guda (가 zuwa 마) a bayaninka?
z-m-10-05.s.s3.model.0: Ga siffofi 가, 나, 라 inda murabba’ai a layi suka ci gaba ba tare da yankewa ba, hanyar Jiho daidai ce. Amma a siffa kamar 다, inda tsakiyar layin sama babu komai kuma sifar ta kewaye gurbin, bangarori da kasan gurbin tsawon ne da murabba’in kewaye ba shi da shi, saboda haka ainihin kewaya ta fi tsawo.
z-m-10-05.s.s3.model.1: A siffar da ke da gurbi a tsakiya, darajar Jiho ta yi ƙasa da ainihin kewaya. 가, 나, 라 ba su da gurbi, don haka darajoji iri ɗaya ne; a 다 da 마 ainihin kewaya ta fi girma saboda bangarorin gurbin biyu.
z-m-10-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa da aka bayyana ta ‘akwai gurbi/babu gurbi’ ma ta dace.
z-m-10-05.s.s3.model.2: A 다 da 마 akwai seli marar cika tsakanin ■ a layin sama, saboda haka kewaya ta fi ta murabba’i girma.

z-m-10-03.title: Polygon yana da diagonal nawa?
z-m-10-03.goal: Ka dandana yadda sabon bayani ke gyara hasashen da aka yi daga ƴan bayanai, ka haɗa adadin diagonal daga kusurwar guda da jimillar diagonal domin bincika dalilin ƙa'idar ma.
z-m-10-03.material: Diagonal shi ne layin da ke haɗa kusurwoyi biyu na polygon da ba maƙwabta ba. A wannan aikin ana la'akari da polygon da ba shi da lanƙwasawa zuwa ciki. Murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu yana da gefuna 4, pentagon 5, hexagon 6, heptagon 7. Babu hoto, don haka ka zana su a takarda idan kana so.
z-m-10-03.thinking.0: Hasashen ƙa'ida daga ƴan bayanai, sannan gwada ta.
z-m-10-03.thinking.1: Yanke shawarar ko sabon bayani yana canza ko ƙarfafa hasashe.
z-m-10-03.prereq.0: Ma'anar diagonal da sunayen murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu, pentagon, hexagon (matakin aji na 4).
z-m-10-03.prereq.1: Rubuta adadin gefuna da ƙirga a tebur gefe da gefe don kwatantawa.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai kashi-kashi. A kowane mataki zaɓi hasashenka, sannan bayan ganin sabon bayanin ka yanke shawarar riƙe ko gyara hasashen.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.hint.0: Idan za ka iya zana, sanya sunayen kusurwoyi, haɗa maki biyu da ba maƙwabta ba, ka rubuta abin da ka ƙirga a tebur.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta ko sabon bayani ya dace ko ya saɓa da hasashen farko; idan ya dace ƙara dalilin, idan bai dace ba yanke abin gyarawa.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Diagonal layi ne da ke haɗa kusurwoyi biyu da ba maƙwabta ba. Ana la'akari da polygon da ba shi da lanƙwasawa zuwa ciki kawai. Sanya sunayen kusurwoyi ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ ka zana da kanka. Na zana na ƙirga, murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu yana da diagonal 2, pentagon kuma 5.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Hexagon da ba a zana ba tukuna, kana tsammanin yana da diagonal nawa?
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.after: A yanzu b da d duka tunani ne masu dacewa. Da bayanai guda biyu kawai, hasashen 'yana ƙaruwa da 3 kowane lokaci' yana buƙatar gwaji.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 10: an samu ta ninka lambobin baya biyu, 2 da 5.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Babu wani abu a bayanan da ke ba da dalilin amincewa da ƙa'idar ninka lambobin biyu. Duba ko hanya ɗaya ta yi daidai ga murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu da alwatika ma.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: 8: ya ƙaru da 3, saboda haka watakila zai ƙaru da 3 kuma.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan hasashe ne da ya faɗaɗa ƙa'idar da aka gano daga bayanai guda biyu. Dole ne a gwada ko ya yi daidai ta hanyar ƙirga hexagon kai tsaye.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: 12: hexagon yana da gefuna 6, saboda haka sau 2 ne na adadin gefuna.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Idan aka yi amfani da ƙa'idar ga murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu (gefe 4, diagonal 2), ba ta dace da bayanin ba.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Yana da wuya a sani yanzu: ina so in zana hexagon in ƙirga kai tsaye.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan hali ne na dakatar da hasashe idan bayanai kaɗan ne, a so a bincika kai tsaye.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Na zana hexagon na ƙirga diagonal, sun kasance 9. Ya zuwa yanzu murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu yana da 2, pentagon 5, hexagon 9.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kana tsammanin heptagon yana da diagonal nawa?
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.after: c ita ce ƙa'idar da aka gano daga bayanai 2,5,9, d kuma halin son gwada ƙa'idar. Duka sun dace. Hasashen farko na '3 kowane lokaci' bai dace da bayanin hexagon ba, saboda haka yana buƙatar gyara. An yi amfani da bayanan 2, 5, 9.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 12: ina tsammanin zai ci gaba da ƙaruwa da 3 a kowane lokaci.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Hexagon ya zama 9, ba 8 ba. Ka sake dubawa ko tunanin ƙaruwa da 3 kowane lokaci ya dace da bayanan yanzu.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 18: ina tsammanin zai zama sau biyu na hexagon. Ninkawa sau 2 ne.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Duba ko ya ninka sau biyu daga murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu zuwa pentagon, da pentagon zuwa hexagon.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: 14: ƙarin sun kasance 3, sai 4, don haka na gaba ya ƙaru da 5.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan hasashe ne da aka samu ta lura da yadda ƙarin suka canza a bayanai 2,5,9. Jerin lambobin shi ne 2, 5, 9.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Yana da wuya a sani yanzu: ina so in zana heptagon in ƙirga kai tsaye.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wannan hali ne na yin hasashe amma son gwada shi ta bincike kai tsaye.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Na ƙirga diagonal da za a iya zana daga kusurwa ɗaya: murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu yana da 1, pentagon 2, hexagon 3. Dalili kuwa ba za a iya zana diagonal zuwa kusurwar kanta da maƙwabta biyu a kowane gefe ba. Heptagon zai iya samun 4 daga kowace kusurwa. Idan aka haɗa adadin da aka ƙirga daga duk kusurwoyi, kowane diagonal an ƙirga shi sau biyu, daga ƙarshen biyu. Daga kusurwa guda: 1, 2, 3.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Heptagon yana da diagonal nawa gaba ɗaya?
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Heptagon yana da diagonal 14. Wannan ya yi daidai da 14 da aka yi hasashe da ƙa'ida tun farko, yanzu kuma mun san dalilin da ya sa 14 ne. Murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu 4×1÷2=2, pentagon 5×2÷2=5, hexagon 6×3÷2=9 duk sun yi daidai.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wannan shi ne adadin da aka ƙirga sau biyu, ɗaya daga kowane ƙarshen. Ka yi tunanin yadda za a ƙirga kowanne sau ɗaya kawai.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 14: haɗa duk lambobin da aka ƙirga sannan a raba da biyu.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan tunani ya gyara ƙirga diagonal ɗaya sau biyu, ya haɗa shi da 14 da aka yi hasashe tun farko.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Bayanin bai bayar da dalilin ƙara ba. Gwada wannan hanya a murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu (4+1), ka duba ko ya dace da 2.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: 4: adadin da za a iya zana daga kusurwa guda.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Bambanta adadin da aka ƙirga daga kusurwa guda da jimillar da aka ƙirga daga duk kusurwoyi.
z-m-10-03.s.s1.reflect: Hasashen farko 'yana ƙaruwa da 3' an gyara shi da bayanin hexagon, 14 na heptagon kuma an tabbatar da shi da ƙa'ida da dalili. Bambanta bayanin da ya canza hasashe da wanda ya ƙarfafa shi.
z-m-10-03.s.s2.prompt: Ga polygon mai gefuna n (babu lanƙwasawa zuwa ciki, n cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 3 zuwa 12), nemo yanayi mabambanta guda uku inda adadin diagonal ya fi adadin gefuna.
z-m-10-03.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta adadin gefuna da diagonal gefe da gefe ga murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu, pentagon, da hexagon.
z-m-10-03.s.s2.hint.1: Faɗaɗa tebur zuwa dama, ka bincika ko diagonal ya fi gefe idan gefuna 7 da 8 ne ma.
z-m-10-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Rubuta adadin gefuna a matsayin cikakkiyar lamba daga 3 zuwa 12.
z-m-10-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Adadin diagonal ya fi adadin gefuna.
z-m-10-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Adadin diagonal bai fi adadin gefuna ba. Kwatanta adadin diagonal da gefuna a tebur ga murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu, pentagon, hexagon.
z-m-10-03.s.s2.explain: Pentagon yana da gefuna 5 da diagonal 5, sun yi daidai. Daga hexagon (gefe 6, diagonal 9) zuwa gaba, diagonal sun fi yawa. Kowace lamba daga 6 zuwa 12 ta dace.
z-m-10-03.s.s3.prompt: Polygon da ba shi da lanƙwasawa zuwa ciki yana da diagonal 10 da za a iya zana daga kusurwa guda. Polygon ɗin yana da gefuna nawa?
z-m-10-03.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta adadin gefuna da diagonal daga kusurwa guda gefe da gefe ga murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu, pentagon, hexagon, ka duba bambancin.
z-m-10-03.s.s3.hint.1: Yi amfani da bambancin da ka samu wajen yanke adadin gefuna idan diagonal 10 ne; sake tabbatar ko alaƙar iri ɗaya ce ga murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu.
z-m-10-03.s.s3.r.a: Wannan tunani ya ɗauki adadin diagonal daga kusurwa guda kamar adadin gefuna. Duba ko lambobin biyu iri ɗaya ne a murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu da pentagon.
z-m-10-03.s.s3.r.b: Wannan hanya ce ta rage 3 daga 10 a baya. Duba bayanai ko adadin diagonal daga kusurwa guda yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa yayin da adadin gefuna ke ƙaruwa.
z-m-10-03.s.s3.r.c: Wannan tunani ya gano bambancin adadin diagonal daga kusurwa guda da adadin gefuna, ya yi amfani da shi a baya.
z-m-10-03.s.s3.r.d: Wannan tunani ya ɗauki bambancin adadin gefuna da diagonal daga kusurwa guda a matsayin ƙari ɗaya. Duba ko ka ƙirga kusurwar kanta da maƙwabtanta biyu.
z-m-10-03.s.s3.explain: Adadin diagonal da za a iya zana daga kusurwa guda shi ne (adadin gefuna)−3. Idan 10 ne, polygon yana da gefuna 13, wato polygon mai gefuna 13. Jimillar diagonal ita ce 13×10÷2=65.

z-m-10-02.title: Idan siffofi suka haɗu a wuri guda, gibi zai rage ko za su yi wa juna karo?
z-m-10-02.topic: Kusurwoyin siffofi da suka taru a wuri guda
z-m-10-02.goal: Amfani da cewa idan aka tara kusurwoyin siffofi a wuri ɗaya, dole jimillarsu ta zama cikakken juyawa (360°) don babu gibi ko karo, yanke hukunci ta kwatanta girman gibin da kusurwar siffa, sannan ka ƙirƙiri mafita da dama da kanka.
z-m-10-02.material: Kusurwar alwatika daidai, murabba’i, da hexagon daidai guda ɗaya ita ce 60°, 90°, da 120° bi da bi. Idan aka tara kusurwoyin siffofi a wuri ɗaya, idan jimillarsu 360° (juyawa cikakkiya) ce, za su dace babu gibi ko karo. Idan jimilla ta yi ƙasa da 360°, gibi zai rage; idan ta fi 360°, siffofin za su yi karo. Wannan aiki yana la’akari da ‘wuri ɗaya kawai’, ba ko za a iya rufe faɗin bene gaba ɗaya ba. Babu hoto.
z-m-10-02.thinking.0: Gwada ikirari ta amfani da girman kusurwoyi
z-m-10-02.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri mafita da dama da suka cika sharudda
z-m-10-02.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa yanayin da ba zai yiwu ba ba zai yiwu ba
z-m-10-02.prereq.0: Juyawa cikakkiya a kusa da wuri guda 360° ce.
z-m-10-02.prereq.1: Kusurwar alwatika daidai, murabba’i, da hexagon daidai 60°, 90°, 120° ne bi da bi (bayanan da aka bayar).
z-m-10-02.s.s1.prompt: Jimin ya tara murabba’ai 3 da alwatika daidai 1 a wuri guda, gibi 30° ya rage. Jimin ya ce, ‘Idan na ƙara alwatika daidai guda ɗaya, gibin zai cika daidai.’ Wane hukunci game da furucin ne daidai?
z-m-10-02.s.s1.hint.0: Gano jimillar kusurwar da murabba’ai 3 da alwatika daidai 1 suka mamaye a wuri guda.
z-m-10-02.s.s1.hint.1: Jera girman gibin da ya rage da kusurwar alwatika daidai guda ɗaya kusa da juna sannan ka kwatanta.
z-m-10-02.s.s1.o.a: Daidai ne. Alwatika daidai ƙarama ce, saboda haka ta dace cikin gibin.
z-m-10-02.s.s1.r.a: Ko siffa ƙarama ce ba za ta shiga ba idan ɗaya daga kusurwoyinta ta fi gibin girma. Dole a duba girman kusurwa ɗaya, ba girman siffar ba.
z-m-10-02.s.s1.o.b: Daidai ne. Gibi ya rage, saboda haka ƙarin siffa irin ɗaya zai cika shi.

z-m-10-01.title: Duba kusurwar da ke tsakanin hannun agogo da Hajun ya samo
z-m-10-01.topic: Kusurwar da hannayen agogo biyu suka yi
z-m-10-01.goal: A cikin mafitar kusurwar agogo, gano layin da hujjarsa ba ta dace ba (inda aka manta motsin hannun sa’a), gyara shi, sannan ka yi amfani da wannan ra’ayi don gano lokutan kusurwa ƙanana da kanka ka bayyana dalili.
z-m-10-01.material:
A fuskar agogo, an sanya lambobi 1 zuwa 12 daidai tazara. Juyawa ɗaya cikakkiya 360° ce, saboda haka tazarar tsakanin lamba da ta gaba 30° ce. Gajeren hannu (na sa’a) yana motsi da sauri ɗaya, sararin lamba ɗaya (30°) a kowace sa’a, dogon hannu (na minti) kuma yana nuni da lamba 6 idan minti 30 ne. Kusurwar hannayen ita ce kusurwar gefen da ba ta fi 180° ba. Babu hoto, don haka ka zana fuskar agogo a tunaninka.
Hajun ya gano kusurwar hannayen biyu da ƙarfe 2:30 kamar haka.

z-m-10-01.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri da kwatanta misalai ta sauya sharudda

z-m-10-01.s.s1.hint.1: Duba layin da ya yi amfani da motsin hannun sa’a a awa guda, ko ya bar shi.

z-m-10-01.s.s1.line.2: Saboda haka a 2:30 ma hannun sa’a har yanzu yana kan lamba 2.
z-m-10-01.s.s1.line.3: Daga lamba 2 zuwa 6 sarari 4 ne, kowane sarari 30° ne, don haka 4×30=120°.
z-m-10-01.s.s1.line.4: Saboda haka kusurwar hannayen agogo biyu 120° ce.
z-m-10-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ba daidai ba ne. Hannun sa’a yana motsi sarari guda (30°) a kai a kai kowane awa, don haka a 2:30 ya wuce lamba 2 da rabin sarari (15°), yana tsakiyar 2 da 3 daidai. Daga hannun sa’a zuwa lamba 6 sarari uku da rabi ne, wato 3.5×30=105°. Layi na 1 daidai ne ga matsayin dogon hannu a minti 30, layi na 2 kuma daidai ne domin hoton ‘da ƙarfe 2 daidai’ ne. Lissafin layi na 4 daidai ne shi kaɗai amma ya yi amfani da matsayin layi na 3 da ba daidai ba, layi na 5 kuma sakamakonsa ne. z-m-10-04.title: Me dole ne ya zama iri ɗaya domin a kira polygon daidai-gefe?
z-m-10-04.goal: Gwada maganganun 'idan gefu daidai' ko 'idan kusurwoyi daidai, polygon daidai-gefe ne' ta misalai masu karyatawa, ka bayyana cewa sharuddan biyun duka ake buƙata.
z-m-10-04.material: Polygon daidai-gefe yana da duk gefuna tsawon iri ɗaya, duk kusurwoyinsa girma iri ɗaya. Ana la'akari da polygon da ba shi da lanƙwasawa zuwa ciki. Rhombus murabba'i ne mai kusurwa huɗu da duk gefuna huɗu tsawon iri ɗaya; rectangle kuma yana da duk kusurwoyi huɗu kusurwoyin dama. Abokai biyu sun ce: Seoha: 'Polygon da duk gefunsa tsawo ɗaya ne polygon daidai-gefe ne.' Roha: 'Polygon da duk kusurwoyinsa girma ɗaya ne polygon daidai-gefe ne.' Babu hoto.
z-m-10-04.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci ko maganganu gaskiya ko ƙarya, ka ƙirƙiri misalai masu karyatawa.
z-m-10-04.thinking.1: Bincika ko sharadi guda ko biyu ake buƙata.
